scope: Local procedural color and mask on existing shoulder triangles between asphalt and foot curb. No new surface, excavation, normal displacement or collision change.
dimensions_status: Texture resolution, artistic inset, feather and palette are authoring choices. Existing margin derives from the engineered parent meshes, not metric photo measurement.
opacity_policy: Keep the source opacity expression outside the local mask; union local mask inside it to expose only the existing shoulder triangles selected for the drainage finish.
